'''Susco's Tavern''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|tavern]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rhol Yan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]]. In [[25,793 BBY]], the [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] drank a local Kalimahr [[Unidentified wine (Kalimahr)|wine]] with [[Tre Sana]] in Susco's Tavern while investigating a group calling themselves the [[Stargazers]].<ref name="Into the Void" />

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Susco's Tavern first appeared in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'', a [[2013]] novel written by [[Tim Lebbon]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
